title: Cone-free sets are countably n-rectifiable (Mattila 15.13; Dall'Alba Lemma 4.5)
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, N := n + ℓ, W ⊆ ℝ^N (= EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) a linear subspace of dimension n and P := W.starProjection its orthogonal projection. Let s > 0, r > 0 and E ⊆ ℝ^N be such that s|b − a| ≤ |P(b − a)| for all a, b ∈ E with |b − a| < r (equivalently, E meets no cone X(a, r, s) = {x : |P(x − a)| < s|x − a|} ∩ B(a, r) with vertex a ∈ E). Then E is countably n-rectifiable: there are M₀ with Hⁿ(M₀) = 0 and Lipschitz maps F_j : ℝⁿ → ℝ^N (j ∈ ℕ) with E ⊆ M₀ ∪ ⋃_j F_j(ℝⁿ).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (W : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ))), finrank ℝ W = n → ∀ (s r : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < r → ∀ E : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), (∀ a ∈ E, ∀ b ∈ E, dist b a < r → s * ‖b - a‖ ≤ ‖W.starProjection (b - a)‖) → CountablyRectifiable n E
